escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood behind-the-scenes still): a vast, dark logistics warehouse at night, tall shelving racks fading into black. Behind Karo and to the camera-right of her, between her body and the right edge of the frame, an Efeonce crew has unfolded a complete, professional PORTABLE STUDIO in the middle of the warehouse floor: two slim current-generation bi-colour LED panels with soft boxes on black C-stands, two slim battery LED tubes standing far behind her, cool white, melted into soft bokeh, a compact current-generation full-frame cinema camera with a matte black body on a carbon-fibre handheld gimbal, a boom microphone, and an empty interview chair with a wireless lavalier microphone clipped to it, all standing inside ONE sharp-edged volume of clean cool-white light that rises from the open road cases and is carved out of the dark warehouse, its edges legible in the haze: the studio unfolded out of the cases. On the floor beside the empty chair, at about 80 % of the frame width, three open hard-shell road cases with empty black foam cut-outs show it all arrived in a few cases. Everything is modern and minimal: no vintage equipment, no tungsten fresnels, no film cameras, no tangled cables. Karo, as in her reference, the director, stands inside the lit set beside the camera, framed from the waist up, wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, IN ACTION, mid-shot: she holds the carbon-fibre gimbal with both hands at chest height and walks a slow, controlled move across the set, her body turned three-quarters toward the camera-right, her eyes on the small screen of the cinema camera, lips parted as she calls the next take; one boom operator, soft and out of focus behind her, follows with the microphone; her left shoulder, the one toward the text, is at about 65 % of the frame width; between the left edge of the frame and her shoulder there is a wide band of empty darkness, and no part of the studio is visible to the left of her left shoulder; she does NOT look at the lens and does NOT look toward the left of the frame: her gaze stays on her camera's screen; the shot is caught in motion, with a slight motion blur only on the moving cables and the boom. LIGHT: the soft box of the nearest LED panel is the only key light on her face, cool white, from the camera-right; NO fill light, the far side of her face in shadow with the nose shadow legible; the rest of the warehouse stays dark. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about five meters away at chest height, 85mm f/2. Thin haze catches the light. The LEFT 60 % of the frame is calm, deep dark space with only faint haze: no objects lit, no light shapes, nothing that glows; everything lit lives between her left shoulder and the right edge of the frame. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos of any brand on any equipment.
